newsitem.title: UK: Brown announces 5-yr deficit reduction plan.
newsitem.headline: Brown announces 5-yr deficit reduction plan.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown announced on Wednesday a five year plan for reducing Britain's budget deficit.

"My first rule -- the golden rule ensures that over the economic cycle the government will borrow only to invest and that current spending will be met from taxation. My second rule is that, as a proportion of national income, public debt will be held at a prudent and stable level over the economic cycle," he said in his budget speech. "To implement these rules I am today announcing a five year deficit reduction plan." -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 5109
